items.markdown:
![Khao Soi: Northern Thai Curry Noodle Soup Recipe](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280323-1672-0139-0000-347d2b2178d9:6)
Khao soi `originated as a fusion dish brought by Chinese-Muslim (Chin Haw) traders traveling from Yunnan through Myanmar and Laos into Northern Thailand` . It evolved from regional noodle soups like Myanmar's *ohn no khao swè* , eventually adapting local Thai coconut milk and crisp toppings.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khao_soi) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khao_soi)[[2]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/)[[3]](https://www.abowlofsugar.com/post/chiang-mai-curry-noodles-khao-soi)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/p/DTlnox3DN-O/)

Cultural and Culinary Evolution

- **Traders and Routes:** Chinese-Muslim traders moved along ancient spice and caravan routes, introducing wheat and rice-based noodle concepts to the region.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khao_soi) 
- **The Name:** "Khao soi" translates loosely to "cut rice" or "sliced/cut noodles", referencing early methods of slicing sheets of noodle dough.[](https://www.abowlofsugar.com/post/chiang-mai-curry-noodles-khao-soi) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fOsque7_d-k)
- **Broth Transformation:** Early iterations featured a clear, simpler broth (*nam sai* ) without coconut milk, which was later enriched with coconut cream, local red and yellow curry spices, and topped with deep-fried crispy noodles.[](https://www.facebook.com/groups/phuketfoodies/posts/2451429558334408/) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/groups/phuketfoodies/posts/2451429558334408/)[[2]](https://thaileefoods.com/new/khao-soi-thai-noodles/)[[3]](https://www.tasteatlas.com/khao-soi)[[4]](https://www.thaicookingkohtao.com/recipe/khao-soi)
